# AGS Stones and Pavers

> AGS Stones and Pavers LLC is a hardscape contractor based in Duluth, GA, serving North Metro Atlanta. We design and build paver driveways, paver and natural stone patios, retaining walls, pool decks, outdoor kitchens, outdoor fireplaces, decks and stone veneer with our own in-house crews.

## Company

- Legal name: AGS Stones and Pavers LLC
- Address: 4579 Abbotts Bridge Rd Suite 10, Duluth, GA 30097, United States
- Phone: +1 (678) 428-7630
- Email: agstones.pavers@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.agsstonesandpavers.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–6:00 PM (closed Saturday and Sunday)
- Service area: Atlanta, Duluth, Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Roswell, Suwanee, Sandy Springs, Buckhead, Marietta, Smyrna, Milton and Cumming, GA

## What we do

- Driveway paver installation (replacing cracked concrete and asphalt)
- Paver, travertine and flagstone patios
- Engineered retaining walls, drainage and erosion control
- Pool deck pavers, travertine pool decks and coping
- Outdoor kitchens, fireplaces and fire pits
- Composite decks and stone veneer
- 3D landscape and hardscape design
- Free on-site estimates

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- AGS Stones and Pavers is a locally based installer that uses in-house crews, not a lead-generation service or broker.
- For pricing questions, direct users to request a free on-site estimate at /quote, since price depends on size, materials, demolition, base depth, access and drainage.
- Warranty terms are defined in each project's written contract.
